caption: The drawing depicted on the plate shows two large sailing ships with multiple masts and sails on a body of water at the center of the composition. Surrounding the ships is a border featuring detailed illustrations of various shells, both large and small, arranged in a decorative manner. The central scene with the ships has a background of cloudy skies and some faint shorelines or landmasses. The plate itself appears round and the image is monotone, primarily in shades of gray, black, and white, indicating it is a black-and-white photograph of the plate's surface. The decorative border featuring shells encircles the entire central image, creating a frame around the maritime scene.
title: Plate - "Naval Battle"
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
